Apple is expanding support for driver's licenses in Apple Wallet to another state. Starting today, residents of Oklahoma can add their driver's license to the Wallet app on iPhone and Apple Watch for convenient mobile access.

Apple Wallet Driver's License Support Expands to New State

To add a driver's license to your iPhone, tap the plus icon in the top-right corner of the Apple Wallet app. You'll then need to scan both the front and back of your driver's license and verify your identity to complete the process.

Oklahoma becomes the 16th U.S. state to roll out Apple Wallet driver's license support. The feature was first announced at WWDC in 2021 and has since been gradually expanding across the country.

Oklahoma was first spotted by MacRumors, and this expansion comes just one week after Virginia launched the feature. States like Kentucky, Utah, Connecticut, Mississippi, and North Carolina are also preparing to support Apple Wallet driver's licenses.

You can use your Apple Wallet driver's license at TSA checkpoints in over 250 airports, as well as at select businesses and venues.

You can check out the full list of states that accept digital driver's licenses in Apple Wallet here:

Regardless of which state you live in, you can still add an ID document version to Apple Wallet. Last year, Apple launched Digital ID, a new feature powered by U.S. passport data, which lets you create a digital version of your passport for use at TSA checkpoints.

Have you used the driver's license or Digital ID feature in Apple Wallet? How was your experience? Let us know in the comments.
